NFAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Sustainable management of resources using science-based information.",
"Action/Intervention": "Ensure sustainable management of living marine resources based on the best available evidence from social, economic and ecological sciences; apply ecosystem and precautionary approaches to promote responsible fisheries management; enhance the stocks of endangered, threatened and protected species; enhance fish stocks in the territorial sea and the exclusive economic zone (EEZ) by ranching and habitat enhancement; prevent overcapacity of the fishing fleet; divert marine fishing efforts from over-exploited areas to unexploited or under-exploited areas; promote the use of fishing practices and equipment that cause comparatively low adverse impacts on the environment; maintain the ban on fishing in Sri Lanka waters by foreign fishing vessels except for research and development purposes; promote responsible fisheries in compliance with requirements stipulated in international treaties concerning management of fisheries; limit new access to high seas fishing only to fishing vessels equipped with state-of-the-art technology for fish detection and on-board fish quality maintenance; apply ecosystem approach to management of fisheries in inland waters; ensure conservation of aquatic biodiversity in inland waters; regulate the length and engine capacity of fishing vessels fishing in lagoons and estuaries; not allow the use of motorized boats for fishing in reservoirs; apply temporal and spatial planning in development of aquaculture; allocate land and water resources for aquaculture projects only after environmental, socio-economic and cultural impact assessments; ensure that aquaculture projects are implemented in strict compliance with conditions of approval; strengthen aquaculture-animal healthcare activities; promote the use of best management practices (BMPs) in aquaculture.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Living marine resources, fisheries, territorial sea, exclusive economic zone (EEZ), high seas fishing, inland waters, lagoons, estuaries, reservoirs, and aquaculture.",
"Target Audience": "Fisheries and aquaculture sectors, including fishing vessels and fisheries operating in marine and inland waters.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable management of living marine resources and fisheries based on science-based information; responsible fisheries management; enhanced stocks of endangered, threatened and protected species and fish stocks; conservation of aquatic biodiversity in inland waters; reduced adverse environmental impacts from fishing practices and equipment; controlled fishing fleet capacity and access; and aquaculture development and implementation carried out under impact assessment, compliance conditions, animal healthcare, and best management practices."
NFAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure compliance with regional and international obligations related to fisheries management, conservation of fisheries resources, and maritime labour.",
"Action/Intervention": "Participate actively in regional and international fisheries management forums; comply with fisheries management measures stipulated in international treaties and by Regional Fisheries Management Organizations (RFMOs); cooperate with other coastal states directly and through RFMOs for conservation and management of highly migratory and straddling fish stocks; cooperate with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in conservation and management of fisheries resources; comply with requirements stipulated in international labour conventions and international maritime conventions regarding maritime labour.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Fisheries management, fisheries resources, highly migratory and straddling fish stocks, and maritime labour.",
"Target Audience": "Parties responsible for fisheries management and maritime labour compliance, including those participating in regional and international fisheries management forums, RFMOs, cooperation with coastal states, and engagement with FAO.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Compliance with regional and international fisheries management, conservation, and maritime labour obligations."
NFAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase marine fisheries production.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen the fisheries forecasting system for fishers to obtain information on locations for productive fishing; promote fishing for un-exploited or under-exploited fish stocks in the EEZ; promote the use of locally produced bait, including live bait, in line fisheries; promote foreign fish landings in a responsible manner in accordance with the relevant international treaties.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Marine fisheries, including the EEZ.",
"Target Audience": "Fishers.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased marine fisheries production."
NFAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase aquaculture and inland fisheries production.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop fisheries and aquaculture as appropriate in inland waters; promote fishing for under-exploited and unexploited fish resources in inland waters; expand and intensify aquaculture through environmentally friendly approaches; promote the culture of indigenous species, and new exotic species in compliance with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Code of Practice for the Introduction of Aquatic Species; genetically improve the performance of fish species used for aquaculture with the application of the precautionary principle.",

"Target Audience": "Fisheries and aquaculture sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased production from aquaculture and inland fisheries."

NFAP_6:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase per capita consumption of fish.",
"Action/Intervention": "Create employment with adequate income levels in the sector to ensure food security of more people; ensure quality and food safety of locally marketed fish and fishery products; promote consumption of sufficient fish for meeting nutritional requirements; stock fish as buffer stocks during gluts to ensure the availability of fish at reasonable prices during lean periods; ensure traceability and transparency at all stages of the value chain process.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Fish and fishery products sector.",
"Target Audience": "People consuming fish; people employed in the sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Higher per capita fish consumption, improved availability of fish at reasonable prices during lean periods, improved quality and food safety of fish and fishery products, improved traceability and transparency in the value chain, and improved food security and nutritional intake."
NFAP_7:
"Goal/Purpose": "Increase export earnings.",
"Action/Intervention": "Promote investments in export-oriented fisheries and aquaculture projects; promote the production of fish and fishery products meeting food safety and quality standards acceptable in the international market and ensure efficient supply chain management; promote the import and culture of new exotic species that have export potential; promote the production and export of live ornamental fish and aquatic ornamental plants; promote market-driven production of fisheries and aquaculture products including innovative products; promote eco-friendly or organic production of fisheries and aquaculture products that fetch higher prices in the international market; provide assistance for branding of Sri Lankan products; promote the construction of fishing vessels, recreational vessels and other vessels for export; work for trade agreements that improve access for export products, including fisheries and aquaculture products, in identified or prioritized international markets.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Fisheries and aquaculture sector, including export production, ornamental aquatic products, vessel construction for export, and international trade/market access.",
"Target Audience": "Investors, producers and exporters in fisheries and aquaculture, producers/exporters of ornamental fish and aquatic ornamental plants, vessel manufacturers/exporters, and Sri Lankan product brands/export sectors.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Higher export earnings; improved international market access; increased production and export of fisheries, aquaculture, ornamental aquatic products, and vessels; improved compliance with international food safety and quality standards; stronger supply chain management; and higher-value exports through branding and eco-friendly or organic production."
NFAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve opportunities for leisure, employment and enterprise development.",
"Action/Intervention": "Generate more employment opportunities in the sector where possible; assist women in fisher communities to set up micro-business enterprises, with special attention to widows; provide training and capacity building programs to help women and marginalized groups take up supplementary income generation activities; encourage communities to commence business activities including integrated sustainable tourism; motivate communities to commence aquaculture or culture-based fisheries as income activities in wetland areas associated with their villages; train school leavers in advanced technology related to fisheries, aquaculture and new marine industries targeting employment; train skippers and crew members for foreign employment; continue implementing poverty alleviation programmes that provide sustainable livelihoods.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Fisheries sector, aquaculture, new marine industries, wetland areas associated with villages, and integrated sustainable tourism.",
"Target Audience": "Women in fisher communities, widows, marginalized groups, communities, school leavers, skippers, crew members, and beneficiaries of poverty alleviation programmes.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "More employment opportunities, establishment of micro-business enterprises, increased supplementary income generation activities, commencement of community business activities including sustainable tourism, uptake of aquaculture or culture-based fisheries as income activities, employment in fisheries, aquaculture and new marine industries, foreign employment for trained skippers and crew members, and sustainable livelihoods through poverty alleviation programmes."
NFAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve the socio-economic conditions of the fisher community.",
"Action/Intervention": "Take measures to prevent alcoholism in fishing communities; ensure that adequate compensation is provided to fisher communities affected by development activities in the respective areas; improve the social safety net and social security protection for fishers and fish workers including women; respect the tenure rights of traditional, migrant, subsistence and artisanal fishing communities to land, waters and fish resources; make right holders responsible for sustainable use of the resources; ensure safe, healthy and fair working conditions at sea, inland waters and on land; involve fishing communities in designing, planning and implementation of fisheries management measures; build the capacity of fishers and ensure their effective participation in fisheries management; promote investment in human resource development such as health, education, literacy and digital inclusion in fishing communities; progressively realize rights of small-scale fishers and fishworkers to an adequate standard of living in accordance with national and international human rights standards.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Fishing communities; fisheries management; sea, inland waters and on land.",
"Target Audience": "Fisher communities; fishers and fish workers including women; traditional, migrant, subsistence, artisanal and small-scale fishing communities; right holders.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved socio-economic conditions of fisher communities, including stronger social protection, respected tenure rights, safer and fairer working conditions, greater participation in fisheries management, improved human resource development, and progressive realization of an adequate standard of living."
